notes: The app has its own login now. Profile slimmed to name, tech ID, email, phone — create your team account right there (Profile → Team account). Tech roster fills itself the moment someone signs up (no more registration emails); bug reports land straight in the admin's app. NEW 'Find part' on Home: search every truck on the team — see who has it, how many, their bin, call them, and how far away they are (location sharing is opt-in, off by default). Your truck syncs to the team cloud automatically. Email is now only used for pulling your min/max report. Also fixes: bins from the cloud now stamp immediately after you import your inventory.
